exposure: Diagnosed gestational diabetes with adequate therapeutic management
outcome: Compliance with recommended postpartum oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: The study included medical data from 80 patients hospitalized in the Department of Perinatology between 2020 and 2022, divided into 40 with undetected hyperglycaemia and 40 with diagnosed gestational diabetes.
finding: Undetected hyperglycaemia in pregnancy was significantly associated with a higher incidence of large for gestational age newborns and neonatal hyperbilirubinemia, and a lower rate of postpartum OGTT compliance, compared to diagnosed and managed gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: No effect of undetected hyperglycaemia on the route of delivery was observed.
birth_weight: Newborn weights were analysed, and incidence of large for gestational age (LGA) was reported.
gest_age: Gestational age was used in the classification of large for gestational age (LGA).
